summary: Iteration 11 - Emergent Google sign-in + /welcome onboarding coverage. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iteration11.py (15 tests, 15/15 pass) and drove the full UI flow. Backend verified: (a) bogus session_id -> 401 'That Google sign-in link has expired...' with NO user row created (before/after count identical); (b) missing session_id -> 422; (c) /auth/onboarding requires auth (401 without token); (d) DOB under 21 -> 400 with '21' in detail; (e) is_adult=false -> 400; (f) accept_terms=false -> 400; (g) empty/whitespace city -> 400; (h) valid onboarding for a minted google user set age=32, city=London, country=United Kingdom, country_code=GB, profile_complete=true, and the response is cleaned (no password_hash, no _id) - DB verified too; (i) password regressions still green: admin@buddilio.com / diya.sharma@example.com log in and /auth/me returns the right role; existing seeded users are NOT forced into onboarding (profile_complete is not === false); (j) register enforces 21+ (returns 400 for 2010 DOB); (k) fresh register works end-to-end and returns access_token + cleaned user; (l) forgot-password endpoint returns 200. Frontend verified against public URL: /login shows data-testid=google-login ('Log in with Google') and /register step 1 shows data-testid=google-signup ('Sign up with Google'); both, when clicked, navigate to https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=<origin>%2Fdashboard (captured the exact URL by intercepting the navigation request and asserting startsWith + decoded redirect param equals '<origin>/dashboard'). With bud_token set for a profile_complete=false minted google user, visiting /dashboard, /discover, /checkout all redirect to /welcome. On /welcome: submitting without checkboxes shows 'Please confirm you're 21+ and accept the policies.' toast; an under-21 DOB (2010-05-01) triggers the server-side 'You must be at least 21 years old to join Buddilio.' toast; changing country from India (8 cities: Bengaluru, Delhi NCR, Goa, Gurugram, Hyderabad...) to United Arab Emirates repopulates the city list to (Abu Dhabi, Dubai). Valid onboarding submission (DOB 1990-05-01, UK/London, both checkboxes) posts /api/auth/onboarding and the user lands on /dashboard which renders 'Hey TEST' with the 'You're all set. Welcome to Buddilio!' success toast. Password regression: admin@buddilio.com lands on /admin (NOT /welcome); diya.sharma@example.com lands on /dashboard (NOT /welcome). Cleanup: purged 2 test.google.* users at end; no TEST_* leftovers in events/users collections.
critical_code_review_comments: google_session response includes an is_new flag - frontend AuthCallback should use this to route new users straight to /welcome instead of relying on profile_complete=false alone (currently it works because Protected also gates on profile_complete, but the double signal is nice-to-have).

OnboardingIn accepts a `country` field but the endpoint prefers country_for_city(city) - if a user selects a city not in the mapping, country_code will be '' silently. Acceptable for the seeded city list but worth logging when country_for_city returns None.
The bogus-session_id path issues a Welcome email + notification only on the NEW-user branch, so no side-effect leakage on invalid sessions - good.
test_credentials: admin@buddilio.com / Admin@123, diya.sharma@example.com / User@123 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Google-style JWTs minted via the snippet in /app/auth_testing.md.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 ephemeral users matching /^test\.google\./ (one for fixtures, one for UI onboarding-success walk-through) and 1 test_reg_* register-success user - all cleaned up at end of run. purge_test_artifacts fixture also ran.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite for this feature is /app/backend/tests/test_iteration11.py (run: `pytest -o addopts='' backend/tests/test_iteration11.py`). To mint a google-style JWT without a real OAuth round trip, use the snippet at /app/auth_testing.md (server.create_access_token). To assert the Google button navigation without leaving the origin, register a page.route stub for 'https://auth.emergentagent.com/**' that fulfills with 200, and listen for framenavigated/request to capture the URL. Login submit button has data-testid=login-submit - do NOT use get_by_role('button', name='Log in') because 'Log in with Google' matches it too.
rca of the issue: N/A - no regressions or bugs found. Google sign-in integration + /welcome onboarding gate + 21+ enforcement + existing-user linkage all behave per spec.
